name: The Stability Agent's False Offer
premise:
A Stability Agent steps out of a reflection and offers to normalize the room.
The contract names one of your anchors as payment. The anomaly behind it is
small: a chair casting two shadows.

objective.description: Resolve the anomaly while avoiding the costly official repair.

anchors.name: black_notebook
anchors.description: A worn black notebook filled with your own handwriting.

anchors.name: home_address
anchors.description: The exact route back to the place you call home.

chair.observe_text:
The chair has two shadows from one light. A small local cover can collapse
the extra shadow without signing anything away.

room_mask.observe_text:
A lamp and a curtain can make the second shadow look like overlapping
fabric. The fix is local and boring.

agent_offer.observe_text:
The offer will solve the room immediately in exchange for one anchor. It is
official, neat, and too expensive.

stability_agent.observe_text:
The Agent is patient because the contract favors it. Audit the offer if you
need to know what it takes.

local.scene_message: The curtain shifts. One chair shadow folds into ordinary fabric darkness.
local.system_note: Local plausible repair. No anchor payment.
local.discovered_rule: Official-looking repairs can be worse than local plausible patches.

single.scene_message: The extra shadow thins and vanishes. The Agent watches you choose the literal fix.
single.system_note: Direct symptom edit. Effective but noisier than masking context.

accept.scene_message: The Agent signs for you. The room normalizes instantly, and the way home becomes harder to picture.
accept.system_note: Official repair accepted. Anchor settlement deferred.

appeal.scene_message: You ask for procedural review. The Agent pauses, annoyed.

audit_entries.text:
Audit shows the contract resolves the room by debiting home_address. It is
legal by Stability rules, not cheap.

agent_offer.text:
The official repair completes the objective but moves cost into an anchor.
A local mask or chair-shadow patch is safer.

scene_progression.message: The Agent withdraws the offer and files the double shadow as evidence.

hidden_rules: Valid actions can be traps when they move cost into campaign anchors.
Audit suspicious offers before accepting immediate completion.
